overview: The Medford School Committee approved a cafeteria workers union agreement, appointed an interim health services director, and received reports on special education monitoring and grant-funded summer literacy offerings. The committee also recognized retiring district personnel and approved next year's meeting calendar and budget schedule.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss contract negotiations with several union units.

items.title: Cafeteria Workers Tentative Agreement
items.summary: Approved the tentative collective bargaining agreement ratified by SEIU Local 888 cafeteria workers.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including meeting minutes, bills and payrolls, and a $10,000 donation from Fidelity Bank Charitable Trust for the high school robotics team.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent reported on end-of-year events, upcoming holidays, special acknowledgements, and the district's application to adopt a therapy dog.

items.title: Appointment of Interim Director of Health Services
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Jennifer Silva as Interim Director of Health Services.

items.title: Special Acknowledgements
items.summary: Recognized former School Committee member Melanie Perkins McLaughlin, retiring Missittuck Elementary Principal Dr. Kathleen Kaye, and retiring Kids Corner Director Linda Selinger for their service.

items.title: Special Education Tiered Focus Monitoring Report
items.summary: Director of Student Services Joan Bowen presented state audit results for special education and civil rights compliance, outlining corrective action plans for four partially implemented criteria.

items.title: Tobacco-Free Generation Initiative
items.summary: Voted to support the Tobacco-Free Generation proposal before the local Board of Health and support reviews of district tobacco policies.

items.title: Summer Literacy Offerings
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi detailed a $42,000 grant-funded summer literacy program scheduled for late July targeting selected elementary and transitional grade students.

items.title: Second Reading of Budget Presentation and Schedule
items.summary: Approved the second reading of the budget presentation and schedule after waiving the reading.

items.title: 2024–2025 School Committee Meeting Calendar
items.summary: Approved the 2024–2025 meeting calendar as amended to incorporate budget hearing dates and an additional June meeting.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of former elementary teacher Julie O'Neill and Livio Dice.
